text:
alice: Quick sync  small rollout tomorrow AM (v2.18.0). Ops asked for a single pasteable blurb + explicit canary cadence + rollback path.

ben: Keep it short and machine-copyable. Ops likes 4 bullets and the exact deploy commands.

frank: Draft below. Please sanity-check wording and the abort thresholds.

frank: • What: server-side prefix caching (flag infra.cache.prefix_v3) to reduce repeated KV lookups.
• Impact: ~9% p90 reduction for seq <=1024; estimated host CPU +4% during bursts. No DB/schema changes.
• Action: /deploy --env staging --tag v2.18.0 --canary 3 (20m) -> 15 (40m) -> 100 (prod). Console toggle: Feature Flags > infra.cache.prefix_v3. Version pin: v2.18.0.
• Rollback: abort and disable flag if error rate +0.4% absolute OR p95 latency +18% sustained for 20m. Fallback: deploy tag v2.17.9.

alice: Two small asks: 1) call out who owns oncall; 2) add a one-line release-notes PR pointer after deploy.

sre-shift: Oncall: @sre-oncall primary, @infra-secondary fallback. I'll monitor errors/p95 and CPU. If I post :rotating_light: we abort immediately.

ben: Add snippet for #deploys (copy/paste) so ops doesn't reformat.

frank: Copyable snippet:
```
/deploy --env staging --tag v2.18.0 --canary 3
# after 20m: /deploy --env staging --tag v2.18.0 --canary 15
# after 40m: /deploy --env prod --tag v2.18.0
```

deploy-bot: Preflight checks passed. Queued job id=1803337777 env=staging tag=v2.18.0 canary=3%. Use `/deploy status 1803337777` to follow logs.

docs-bot: Suggested release-notes PR template: add short summary + perf numbers + rollback instructions. Use PR title: "release(v2.18.0): prefix-cache opt-in". I'll create draft PR when deploy reaches prod.

alice: Legal confirmed: "No additional customer PII or telemetry collected." Add that one-liner to blurb.

frank: Final internal blurb (paste into #deploys):
"""
:sparkles: What: server-side prefix caching (flag: infra.cache.prefix_v3).
:zap: Impact: ~9% p90 reduction for seq <=1024; expected host CPU +4% during bursty traffic. No DB or schema changes.
:wrench: Action: /deploy --env staging --tag v2.18.0 --canary 3 (20m) -> 15 (40m) -> prod. Toggle in Console > Feature Flags. Version pin: v2.18.0.
:rotating_light: Rollback: abort if error rate +0.4% absolute OR p95 latency +18% sustained for 20m -> disable flag infra.cache.prefix_v3 + deploy v2.17.9.
:link: Dashboards: p90 / errors / hosts (links in thread).
:person_with_turban: Oncall: @sre-oncall (primary), @infra-secondary (fallback).
:paperclip: Release notes PR will be created after prod ramp. No new PII/telemetry collected.
"""

ben: I'll paste dashboard links and pin after deploy-bot posts status.

sre-shift: I'll be watching metrics and will call abort in-thread if thresholds are exceeded.

alice: Great work. I'll schedule the post T-25 and tag release-notes PR once docs-bot creates it.

deploy-bot: Deployment started (1803337777) -> staging canary 3%. Logs: https://logs.redwood/deploy/1803337777

frank: Saved final copy to release-notes draft. Thanks everyone.
